question: When coal and petroleum are burnt in insufficient air (oxygen), which harmful gas is produced, causing pollution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Carbon monoxide**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• When coal and petroleum are burnt in insufficient air (oxygen), **carbon monoxide (CO) **is produced.
 
• Carbon monoxide is a harmful gas that causes pollution.
 
• It is a colorless, odorless, and tasteless gas that is produced by the incomplete combustion of carbon-containing fuels.
 
• Carbon monoxide is a toxic gas that can cause headaches, dizziness, nausea, and even death at high concentrations.
 
• Oxides of nitrogen (NOx), carbon dioxide (CO2), and sulfur dioxide (SO2) are also produced when coal and petroleum are burnt, but these gases are not produced in as large quantities as carbon monoxide when combustion is incomplete.

**Therefore, the correct answer is 3) Carbon monoxide.**
